text: The private pool villa was a dream — waking up to the jungle and rice fields was unforgettable. Staff went above and beyond.
Our guide made the Louvre come alive. We'd have been lost without her and skipping the line saved us hours.
Incredible access to the arena floor. Slightly rushed at the end but genuinely a highlight of Rome.
Early access to the Sistine Chapel with barely anyone there was magical. Highly recommend booking the first slot.
Best skyline views in Tokyo. Spotless rooms and the location by Shinjuku station is unbeatable.
Marina Bay lived up to the hype — the rooftop infinity pool alone is worth the stay.
The Tsukiji food tour was the tastiest morning of our trip. So much variety and history.
Beautiful cycling route through the terraces. Bring sunscreen — it gets hot fast!
Gorgeous riverside property. Breakfast spread was enormous. Rooms could use a small refresh.
Snorkeling with manta rays off Nusa Penida was surreal. The crew were fantastic and safe.
Impeccable little hotel in the Marais. Perfect base for wandering Paris on foot.
Long but rewarding day trip to Fuji. The lake cruise views were stunning on a clear day.
Charming Trastevere hideaway. The rooftop terrace at sunset is not to be missed.
Learned to cook four dishes I've since made at home. The chef was hilarious and patient.
Came back a second time — still the most peaceful place we've ever stayed in Bali.
